message.content:
Based on the provided screenshot of the GPX Repair Studio "Photo geotagging" feature, here is the QA review:

1.  **Text Clipping in Photo List**: The filename **"IMG_0003.heic"** in the third photo card is visibly clipped on the right side, cutting off part of the ".heic" extension. (Location: Right-side panel, under the "1 of 2 matched" header).
2.  **Inconsistent Button Styling**: The **"Add with write access"** button uses a white background with a dark border (outlined style), while the adjacent **"Add photos"** button uses a light gray background with a dark border (filled/secondary style). This creates a visual hierarchy inconsistency for primary actions in the same group. (Location: Top of the right-side panel).
3.  **Low Contrast Warning Text**: The helper text **"Photos within ±120s of the track match..."** and the footer text **"Photos never leave this device..."** appear to use a very light gray color. The contrast against the cream/paper background looks potentially low and may fail WCAG AA standards for small text. (Location: Below the "Camera clock nudge" slider and at the very bottom of the right panel).
4.  **Truncated Map Labels**: Several street labels on the map are truncated with ellipses or cut off abruptly at tile boundaries, specifically **"OAKLEIGH SOUTH -..."** and **"CLAYTON - Welli..."**. While common in map rendering, it affects readability. (Location: Center and right-center areas of the map).
5.  **Tight Spacing on Error Message**: The vertical spacing between the error message **"HEIC/HEIF — Apple's camera format..."** and the bottom action buttons (**Download tagged copies**, **Clear photos**) appears compressed (likely less than 16-20px), making the error block feel crowded against the footer. (Location: Bottom of the right-side panel).
